01 / The problem

Scattered channels are not a strategy.

One team runs the ads. Someone else built the site. Search is an afterthought. Email gets sent when someone remembers. Creative is produced without performance data. Reporting tells you what happened without telling you what to do next.

The problem is not a lack of marketing. It is a lack of orchestration. CULT. connects the work around one audience, one commercial objective, and one scoreboard.

01/Strategy

Find the signal.

Before another dollar moves, determine what actually needs to change. Positioning, audiences, funnels, and growth roadmaps around a defined commercial outcome.

02/Creative

Earn the attention.

The media cannot save creative nobody notices. Concepts, hooks, video, static, copy, and testing systems built for the places people actually look.

03/Media

Put it in front of the right people.

Meta. Google. TikTok. LinkedIn. Reddit. Programmatic. Retargeting. Every dollar gets a job.

04/Search

Capture the demand already there.

SEO, answer-engine visibility, service pages, content systems, and search strategy around what your buyers are actually trying to find.

05/Conversion

Make the attention worth something.

Websites, landing pages, email, lifecycle, lead capture — conversion systems that move people beyond the first click.

06/Measurement

Know what moved.

Tracking, dashboards, attribution, testing, CRO, and reporting designed to improve the next decision—not just document the last one.

Attention can be bought.
